metric: OpenLineage's own lineage tests (Apache-2.0, commit 7a84fd4d48) for a Rust parser (sqlparser-rs) that shares no code with sqlglot: the independent oracle. Each case is one SQL statement with its expected table and column lineage; KumoSQL must produce exactly it or say unknown.
correctness: 0 cases claim a table or edge the oracle does not have; 0 confident misses
caveats: Cases left out: 46 (other dialects, upstream-skipped tests, USE state, not BigQuery); 18 upstream tests could not be harvested. Statements other than queries and CREATE ... AS (DELETE, UPDATE, MERGE, ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE) are not traced and are reported unknown.
analysis: 49/49 expected column edges found (column cases only; recall counts edges reported unknown)
held_out: Held out: the other-dialect cases (Snowflake, MySQL, T-SQL and so on, read as BigQuery) were never adjudicated or used to shape the adapter, so they are an unseen generalisation check; first run: datahub: 37/80 exact, 17 unknown, 16 missed, 9 wrong; openlineage: 10/29 exact, 1 unknown, 6 missed, 12 wrong. Their wrong/missed counts are dialect differences and are not in the headline. The in-scope cases are not held out: each mismatch was read while building the adapter.
